sections.title: About Vintage
sections.intro: Vintage is a 1960s sports car's dashboard: a cream enamel dial in a knurled chrome bezel over a matching clock, on walnut, with drum counters and jewel lamps in chrome cups.

items.alt: The Vintage style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Vintage, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Vintage once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Vintage's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: Layouts made with Vintage
sections.intro: Drivers built these layouts in Vintage and shared them in the app's layout market, most used first. Every layout works in every style.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Amber Night style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Amber Night
items.text: Night luxury: one big amber-lit dial over a dot-matrix information display.

image.alt: The Rally style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Rally
items.text: Racing: a big white tacho, a rally computer's reflective LCD and a strip of small dials.

image.alt: The Glass style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Glass
items.text: A HUD: glowing cyan arcs and thin digits floating in brackets, no round gauges.

image.alt: The Cockpit style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Cockpit
items.text: An aircraft panel: caption lights, luminous drum counters and a clock on a riveted plate.
